summary: The business-and-markets material now combines independent creator economics with market-positioning strategy. One thread shows that bootstrapped SaaS and programmer freelancing depend on revenue stability, modular infrastructure, customer learning, marketing, support, and personal branding rather than technical building alone. The newer strategy thread adds that crowded markets require a noticeable reason to choose: firms must manage copyable features, category saturation, buyer familiarity, brand distinctiveness, and sometimes category creation or blue-ocean reframing.
